set_max_parallel_elements: set the default maximum parallel elements value for curvature estimation tradeoff
get_max_parallel_elements: get the current default maximum parallel elements value used in curvature blocks
set_default_eigen_decomposition_threshol: set the default eigen decomposition threshold for switching from matrix power to eigenvector decomposition
to_real_set: convert a scalar, sequence, or set of real numbers into a set of scalars
compatible_sum: sum a tensor over specified axes to achieve a target shape while skipping certain axes
